answer: Contractors were booking unpaid tide-gauge visits with copied depth strips. A station is credited only after the tender seats a 22-kg anchor on the listed seafloor pad, photographs an 11-facet crystal serial bonded to the mast, and streams a 40-second calibration ping from 180 m in open ocean, locking 27 POA for 7 epochs. Three duty watchers rebuild the spectrogram in 0.7 s and must read the same facet count. A second station in the same epoch, or two pings that agree on 18 of 20 frequency bins, forfeits 16 POA and keeps that key off the gauge roster for 6 epochs.
